fields.description: Issue includes investigative and editorial coverage alleging excessive telephone rates charged by the Southern Bell Telephone Company in Miami and criticizing inaction by the Florida Railroad Commission; reports on federal investigation activity related to the Miami-Biltmore jewel robbery suspects Nicky Montone and Charles Cali and mentions clerk George F. McCall; extensive reporting on municipal crackdown on marble board and mechanical gambling devices led by City Solicitor Abe Aronovitz; opinion column opposing proposed laws making it a felony to pay ransom to kidnappers; sports/boxing commentary (including Carnera–Louis) and racing tip advertisements/columns ("Jockey Jimmy").
